dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Basic Graph Theory » Cycles
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture Let $ C $ be a circuit in a bridgeless cubic graph $ G $ . Then there is a five cycle double cover of $ G $ such that $ C $ is a subgraph of one of these five cycles.
dossier_meta.context_text: A cycle in $ G $ is meant to be a $ 2 $ -regular subgraph of $ G $ . A five cycle double cover of $ G $ is a set of five cycles of $ G $ such that every edge of $ G $ is contained in exactly two of these cycles. This conjecture is a combination and thus strengthening of the $ 5 $ -cycle double cover conjecture and the strong cycle double cover conjecture.
